text: dsh-llm-multimodal 是面向 DSH Web 的多模态生成插件，在聊天工具中注册文本、图像、视频、视觉问答、语音合成和音乐生成能力，并提供设置面板选择模型。它从 llm-pi-ai 配置发现模型；文本调用 DSH 的 LlmRuntime，其他模态使用兼容 API。生成媒体可保存到活动 media-studio 项目或本地目录。适合需要在 DSH 对话中生成或理解多种媒体的用户；需配置可用模型及其服务凭据。

dsh-llm-multimodal adds six tools to DSH Web chat for text, image, video, vision, speech and music, and a settings card. It discovers models from llm-pi-ai and calls compatible providers. Media can be saved to an active media-studio project or a local directory. Configure a model and credentials.
想在 DSH 聊天里直接生成图片和短视频。
让对话助手根据我上传的几张图回答问题。
有没有办法在 DSH 里把一段文字转成语音？
我想用对话生成背景音乐或音效。
给 DSH 接上多模态模型，文本和媒体生成都能从聊天调用。
I want to ask questions about several images inside my DSH chat.
Can I create a video from a prompt or a starting image in DSH?
I need DSH to turn written dialogue into speech or background music.
**dsh-llm-multimodal** 的功能「文本生成」：在 DSH 对话中调用已配置的语言模型生成文本。工具可指定 `<provider>/<model>`，也能自动选择文本模型，并支持 system prompt。
**dsh-llm-multimodal** 的功能「图像生成与编辑」：根据提示生成图像，也可传入一张或多张图片做编辑或组合。工具接收尺寸和数量参数，并返回生成结果及保存位置。
**dsh-llm-multimodal** 的功能「视频生成」：按文字描述生成短视频，也支持图片转视频及关键帧模式。调用时可设置时长、画幅、负面提示词和关键帧，生成任务通过 provider 接口提交。
**dsh-llm-multimodal** 的功能「多图视觉问答」：向视觉模型发送问题和一张或多张图片，获取自然语言回答。图片可来自 URL、Data URI 或本地路径，并能附带历史对话及细节级别参数。
**dsh-llm-multimodal** 的功能「语音与音乐生成」：把文字合成为语音，或根据文字提示生成音乐和音效。可指定音色、语速与输出格式；提供参考音频和名称时还能克隆并复用角色音色。
dsh-llm-multimodal 使用前须知：需在模型配置中提供可用 provider 和凭据；生成请求发往所选 provider 的兼容 API。
dsh-llm-multimodal 使用前须知：生成的媒体会写入活动 media-studio 项目；项目不可用时回退到配置目录，默认是 /tmp。

dsh-llm-multimodal README · 图像生成：支持任何 OpenAI 兼容的 `/images/generations` 端点，已适配：

DALL-E / Flux / Imagen / Midjourney / SDXL / Kandinsky

dsh-llm-multimodal README · 视频生成：支持 OpenAI Sora 风格 `/videos/generations` 与 Agnes 风格 `/videos`，已适配：

Sora / Seedance / Kling / Veo / Runway / Pika / Hunyuan Video / CogVideo / MiniMax Hailuo

支持文生视频、图生视频（传 `image`）与关键帧模式（传 `keyframes`，首帧/尾帧映射到 provider 的 first_frame / last_frame）；`mode` 可显式指定 `text` / `keyframe` / `reference`。`duration` 默认 5 秒（Agnes 2.5 Flash 接受 4–12），画幅走 `size`（OpenAI 用像素如 `1280x720`，Agnes 用档位如 `720P`）；另有 `negative_prompt`。`num_frames` / `frame_rate` 已不再接受——帧数由 provider 决定。

dsh-llm-multimodal README · 视觉理解：`generate_vision` 走 OpenAI 兼容 `/chat/completions` 多模态内容协议（text + image_url），一次可传多张图（Data URI Base64、`file://` 或绝对本地路径会自动转 Data URI）：

GPT-4o Vision / Claude 3 Vision / Gemini Vision / Qwen-VL / LLaVA / InternVL / Pixtral / PaliGemma / GLM-4V / Mantis …

参数：`prompt`（必填）、`images`（支持多张）、`model`、`system`、`max_tokens`（默认 1024）、`temperature`（默认 0.2，偏事实型视觉问答）、`top_p`、`detail`（`low` 固定 85 token / `high` 分块计费，OCR 与细节场景用 `high` / `auto` 由模型决定）。
dsh-llm-multimodal README · 文本生成：`generate_text` 走 harness 的 LlmRuntime（`ctx.llm.prepareCall`），由 harness 内部多协议路由处理，协议不受 OpenAI 限制；model id 形如 `<provider>/<model>`。

dsh-llm-multimodal README · 配置说明：1. 在「设置 > 模型」中添加一个 provider，`baseURL` 指向你的 API 网关
2. 在模型 id 中包含 image / video 关键词，插件会自动识别
3. 设置 `apiKeyEnv` 环境变量，或在 provider 配置中直接填写 apiKey
4. 重启 `dsh web`

示例 `llm-pi-ai` 配置结构：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    - id: openai
      baseURL: https://api.openai.com/v1

dsh-llm-multimodal README · 使用方式：在 DSH 对话中直接调用工具：

- 生成文本：直接提问，助手会调用 `generate_text`
- 生成图像：描述你想要的画面，助手会调用 `generate_image`
- 生成视频：描述你想要的视频内容，助手会调用 `generate_video`
- 视觉理解：给出图片（路径或链接）并提问，助手会调用 `generate_vision`
- 生成语音/音乐：`generate_tts`（文本 → 语音）与 `generate_music`（音乐/BGM/音效，共用 OpenAI 兼容 `/audio/speech` 端点）

工具会自动从配置中发现可用模型，无需额外参数。

dsh-llm-multimodal README · 语音合成与音色克隆：- 生成语音：`generate_tts`（文本 → 语音）与 `generate_music`（音乐/BGM/音效，共用 OpenAI 兼容 `/audio/speech` 端点）
- **模型按模态分离**：`generate_tts` 只用 TTS 类模型（id 含 `tts/speech/voice/minimax/voxcpm/cosyvoice`）；`generate_music` 只用 music 类模型（id 含 `music/song/lyric`）。TTS 模型不会服务于 music，反之亦然
- **OpenAI 协议**：5 个多模态工具（image / video / vision / tts / music）走 OpenAI 兼容端点；provider 默认 `apiProtocol: openai`；显式配置为其他协议（如 `claude`）时工具会在调用前拒绝并给出可操作提示。`generate_text` 不在此列，它走 harness 的 LlmRuntime（`ctx.llm.prepareCall`），由 harness 内部多协议路由处理
- 预设音色：`voice` 参数填 MiniMax 预设 id（如 `female-shaonv` / `male-qn-jingying`），或直接填已克隆的 voice_id
- 角色专属音色（克隆）：传 `clone_audio`（参考音频：本地路径 / `file://` / http(s) URL / `data:audio` base64）+ `voice_name`（建议用角色名）
  - 首次调用自动执行「上传音频 → 注册 voice_id → 用克隆音色朗读」
  - 后续相同 `voice_name` 调用直接复用已克隆音色（持久化在 `~/.dsh/llm-multimodal-voices.json`），零额外网络开销
  - 可选 `clone_voice_id` 自定义 voice_id；`output_format` 支持 `mp3` / `wav` / `pcm` / `aac` / `flac` / `opus`
  - 需要 provider 支持 MiniMax 兼容的 `files/upload` + `voice_clone` 接口

dsh-llm-multimodal README · 输出路由（media-studio 集成）：安装 [dsh-media-studio](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-media-studio) 后（默认 `outputStrategy=project`），生成产物不再写 `/tmp`，而是直接落盘到**当前活跃 media-studio 项目**：

```
<project sourcePath>/assets/characters/…  # generate_image（默认 asset_kind=character，可传 scene/prop/conceptart/reference）
<project sourcePath>/assets/clips/…       # generate_video
<project sourcePath>/assets/audio/…        # generate_tts / generate_music
```

dsh-llm-multimodal README · 输出路由（media-studio 集成）：返回结果附带 `projectId` 与 `canvasUrl`；配合 media-studio 的 `canvas_graph_patch` `batchAddMedia`，媒体一步挂到画布节点。未安装 media-studio（或服务缺失 / 无活跃项目）时回退 `outputDir` 策略（默认 `/tmp`），零硬依赖。

想直接在聊天里看到这些本地产物的播放预览，另装 [media-preview](https://www.npmjs.com/package/media-preview)。

dsh-llm-multimodal README · 限制：- 当前版本自动 provider 配置界面已暂停；工具通过 `llm-pi-ai` 设置自动发现模型
- 视频生成采用轮询，最长等待约 10 分钟
- 需要 provider 支持 OpenAI 兼容接口（`generate_text` 除外，走 harness LlmRuntime 多协议路由）

> **DSH plugin: six generation tools for text / image / video / vision / speech / music, backed by OpenAI-compatible APIs.**

dsh-llm-multimodal README · dsh-llm-multimodal：`generate_text` / `generate_image` / `generate_video` / `generate_vision` / `generate_tts` / `generate_music` are auto-discovered from the existing `llm-pi-ai` settings. Any model whose id contains image / flux / dall / imagen / sdxl / realesrgan / juggernaut / photoreal / video / sora / seedance / kling / veo / runway / pika / wan / ltx / cogvideox / seedvr / musetalk / lipsync / vision / qwen-vl / llava / internvl / pixtral / glm-4v / tts / speech / voice / minimax / voxcpm / cosyvoice / music / song / lyric becomes an available tool target automatically.
dsh-llm-multimodal README · Companion plugins：This plugin forms a complete **generate → orchestrate → preview** loop with two sibling DSH plugins by the same author. Install them together:

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Companion plugins：| Plugin | Role | npm |

| [dsh-media-studio](https://github.com/xiaokaizhou/dsh-media-studio) | Multi-project infinite canvas: lands generated media on canvas nodes, plus a per-project asset library and global search. `canvas_refresh_node` calls back into this plugin's generators | [npm: dsh-media-studio](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-media-studio) |
| [media-preview](https://github.com/xiaokaizhou/dsh-media-preview) | Renders local/online media paths in chat as playable previews (Range / caching / 27 formats) | [npm: media-preview](https://www.npmjs.com/package/media-preview) |

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Companion plugins：- **Generate + orchestrate**: `dsh-media-studio` publishes the cross-plugin `mediaStudio` service (soft reference, no hard dependency). With the default `outputStrategy=project`, this plugin's `generate_image` / `generate_video` / `generate_tts` / `generate_music` write straight into the active media-studio project's `/assets//` (images default to `character`, pass `asset_kind=scene` for backgrounds; video → `clips`; audio → `audio`). Results carry `projectId` + `canvasUrl`, so `canvas_graph_patch`'s `batchAddMedia` attaches them to canvas nodes in one step. When media-studio is absent or has no active project, the plugin falls back to the `outputDir` strategy (default `/tmp`) — install order does not matter. - **Preview**: `media-preview` renders the `file://` paths this plugin produces as inline `

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Image generation：Any OpenAI-compatible `/images/generations` endpoint. Works with:

DALL-E / Flux / Imagen / Midjourney / SDXL / Kandinsky

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Video generation：OpenAI Sora-style `/videos/generations` and Agnes-style `/videos` endpoints. Works with:

Sora / Seedance / Kling / Veo / Runway / Pika / Hunyuan Video / CogVideo / MiniMax Hailuo

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Video generation：Supports text-to-video, image-to-video (pass `image`), and keyframe animation (pass `keyframes` — first/last map to the provider's first_frame / last_frame); `mode` accepts `text` / `keyframe` / `reference` explicitly. `duration` defaults to 5s (Agnes 2.5 Flash accepts 4–12), and framing goes through `size` (pixels such as `1280x720` for OpenAI, tiers such as `720P` for Agnes); `negative_prompt` is also available. `num_frames` / `frame_rate` are no longer accepted — the provider picks the frame count.

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Vision understanding：`generate_vision` speaks the OpenAI-compatible multimodal `/chat/completions` protocol (text + image_url parts) and accepts multiple images per call (Data URI Base64, `file://`, or absolute local paths are converted to Data URIs automatically):

GPT-4o Vision / Claude 3 Vision / Gemini Vision / Qwen-VL / LLaVA / InternVL / Pixtral / PaliGemma / GLM-4V / Mantis …

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Vision understanding：Parameters: `prompt` (required), `images` (multiple allowed), `model`, `system`, `max_tokens` (default 1024), `temperature` (default 0.2, tuned for factual visual QA), `top_p`, and `detail` (`low` = 85 fixed tokens / `high` = per-tile cost for OCR and fine detail / `auto` = model decides).

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Text generation：`generate_text` routes through the harness LlmRuntime (`ctx.llm.prepareCall`), so the harness handles multi-protocol routing and it is not restricted to OpenAI. Model ids use the `<provider>/<model>` shape.

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Configuration：1. Add a provider in **Settings > Models** with a `baseURL` pointing to your API gateway
2. Make sure the model id contains image / video keywords so the plugin auto-discovers it
3. Set `apiKeyEnv` in your shell, or fill `apiKey` directly in provider settings
4. Restart `dsh web`

Example `llm-pi-ai` config:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    - id: openai
      baseURL: https://api.openai.com/v1

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Usage：Call tools directly in DSH chat:

- Text: ask a question; the assistant will call `generate_text`
- Image: describe the image you want; the assistant will call `generate_image`
- Video: describe the video you want; the assistant will call `generate_video`
- Vision: attach or point at images and ask about them; the assistant will call `generate_vision`
- Speech: `generate_tts` (text → speech) and `generate_music` (music / BGM / SFX, same OpenAI-compatible `/audio/speech` endpoint)
dsh-llm-multimodal README · Usage：The tools auto-discover available models from configuration; no extra parameters required.

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Speech synthesis and voice cloning：- **Modality-separated models**: `generate_tts` only uses TTS-classified models (id contains `tts/speech/voice/minimax/voxcpm/cosyvoice`); `generate_music` only uses music-classified models (id contains `music/song/lyric`). Neither serves the other
- **OpenAI protocol**: the five multimodal tools (image / video / vision / tts / music) speak OpenAI-compatible endpoints; providers default to `apiProtocol: openai`, and an explicit non-OpenAI protocol (e.g. `claude`) is rejected before the call with an actionable message. `generate_text` is exempt — it routes via the harness LlmRuntime (`ctx.llm.prepareCall`)
- Preset voices: pass a MiniMax preset id (e.g. `female-shaonv` / `male-qn-jingying`) as `voice`, or an existing cloned voice_id
- Per-character voice (cloning): pass `clone_audio` (reference audio: local path / `file://` / http(s) URL / `data:audio` base64) plus `voice_name` (use the character's name)
  - The first call runs "upload audio → register voice_id → speak with the cloned voice" automatically
  - Later calls with the same `voice_name` reuse the cloned voice (persisted in `~/.dsh/llm-multimodal-voices.json`)

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Output routing (media-studio integration)：With [dsh-media-studio](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-media-studio) installed (default `outputStrategy=project`), generated media no longer lands in `/tmp` but writes directly into the **active media-studio project**:

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Output routing (media-studio integration)：```
<project sourcePath>/assets/characters/…  # generate_image (asset_kind defaults to character; scene/prop/conceptart/reference also accepted)
<project sourcePath>/assets/clips/…       # generate_video
<project sourcePath>/assets/audio/…        # generate_tts / generate_music
```

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Output routing (media-studio integration)：Results carry `projectId` and `canvasUrl`; pair them with media-studio's `canvas_graph_patch` `batchAddMedia` to attach media to canvas nodes in one step. Without media-studio (or with no active project) the plugin falls back to the `outputDir` strategy (default `/tmp`) — no hard dependency.

To preview those local artifacts inline in chat, install [media-preview](https://www.npmjs.com/package/media-preview) alongside.

dsh-llm-multimodal README · Limitations：- Manual provider configuration UI is paused in this build; use `llm-pi-ai` settings for provider discovery
- Video generation uses polling and may wait up to ~10 minutes
- Provider must support an OpenAI-compatible interface (`generate_text` excepted — it routes via the harness LlmRuntime)
